name: use-current-organization
title: useCurrentOrganization
description: The signed-in user's active organization and a switchTo action, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the organizations block (`npx better-supabase add organizations`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/organizations#switching-organizations.
